Despite the strict manufacturing standards, all ingredients are sourced locally. Therefore, its flavour varies across different planets. Some planets are known for gamy meat and root vegetables from the incimal biosphere with an intensely hot sauce. Others prefer more carefully farmed domestic kettles and leaf vegetables with a mild, sweet taste. Even industrial worlds came up with their own recipes, with synthetic protein and vitamins matching surprisingly well with a salty stock, nurturing the heavy-duty crews.
Serves three to four, vacuum-sealed. Heat all contents in the spherical container before serving.
